sub_answers.text: Congressional committees hold oversight hearings to review the performance of government officials and federal programs, which can address decisions by cabinet secretaries such as the Secretary of Transportation [d8107490s2p0]. Confirmation hearings offer an opportunity for oversight into the activities of a nominee's department or agency and can be controversial [d8107490s4p0]. Congressional hearings are the principal formal method by which committees collect and analyze information in the early stages of legislative policymaking [d8107490s0p0].
